name: Sons of Italy
description: Sons of Italy was a white Italian greaser gang active on Chicago's South Side in the 1950s and early 1960s, concentrated in the Englewood neighborhood around 69th Street and Hermitage. Also known as the 69th Street Loafers, members were mostly Italian and primarily attended Harper High School. They were one of the more powerful South Side greaser gangs of the era and were the first major rivals of the Disciples, opposing demographic changes in the neighborhood by targeting Black youths. They were also rivals of the Cornell Square Rebels; a 1956 shooting death resulted from a multi-gang fight involving the Rebels, Sons of Italy, Sons of Chinatown, and the Cavaliers.
